key_insight: ElasticTTT fixes a core test-time tuning failure in video editing—prior collapse—by preserving the pretrained diffusion model’s generative distribution while adapting to the target edit.
engineering_relevance: The method improves one-shot video editing reliability by making test-time tuning less prone to overfitting to the source video and more faithful to text-guided edits.
method: Target Distribution Regularization to avoid sharp memorization minima during tuning.
Contrastive CFG to push generation away from source-video biases and toward the edit prompt.
Asynchronous Noise Schedule to better protect unedited regions from unwanted changes.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive evaluations and theoretical analysis, with ElasticTTT achieving state-of-the-art performance on one-shot video editing.
watch_item: Test-time tuning can be sensitive to hyperparameters and noise scheduling, so preserving edit quality while avoiding over-constrained updates may require careful implementation.
paper_title: ElasticTTT: Prior-Preserving Test-Time Tuning for Video Editing
